categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: wire rod industry (including PC steel wire, high-strength wire, galvanized wire), bar industry (including general and stainless steel bars), and aluminum continuous casting bars. It also engages in manufacturing and sales of steel products, aluminum alloy billets, and related construction materials and automotive parts.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced secondary processing techniques such as drawing and heat treatment for wire rods, and continuous horizontal and vertical casting technologies for aluminum fine bars. It applies high-frequency heat treatment for PC steel wire and uses specialized dies and drawing equipment for stainless steel bars. The aluminum continuous casting employs innovative continuous casting methods enabling production of small diameter bars without extrusion.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industries such as automotive, construction, shipbuilding, electronics, and machinery manufacturing. The company supplies materials for infrastructure projects (bridges, railroads, nuclear plants), automotive parts (including electric vehicle components), and general industrial applications. The domestic market dominates sales, with some exports to overseas construction and automotive sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates in South Korea with production facilities in Anseong and Pohang. Its sales focus on the domestic market, especially the Seoul metropolitan area and central regions, while also pursuing export opportunities in East Asia and North America for automotive and construction materials.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as a midstream processor, purchasing raw wire rods and aluminum ingots from primary steelmakers and aluminum producers, then performing secondary processing and manufacturing to produce finished wire rods, bars, and aluminum billets for downstream industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding high-value-added product lines such as stainless steel bars and aluminum fine bars for automotive lightweighting. The company invests in capacity expansion and process improvements, including new surface treatment lines and continuous casting technology enhancements. It focuses on quality leadership and rapid delivery to strengthen market position and respond to growing electric vehicle demand.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of steel wire rods, bars, and aluminum continuous casting bars. Sales are mostly domestic with a small export portion, and the company emphasizes direct sales to end users and distributors. Pricing is influenced by raw material costs, which are largely passed through to customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Korean steelmakers such as Korea Steel (고려제강), Manho Steel (만호제강), and DSR Steel (DSR제강) in the wire rod segment, and SeAH Special Steel (세아특수강) and T-plex in the bar segment. The company holds a strong market position with approximately 14.4% share in wire rods and 40% in stainless steel bars, leveraging early product development and quality advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported annual revenues around 180 billion KRW with a recent decline from 196 billion KRW in 2022. Total assets are approximately 179 billion KRW with equity around 153 billion KRW. Production capacity utilization varies by segment, with overall utilization around 63%. The company experienced operating losses in 2023 but maintains stable financial footing and is investing in growth areas like aluminum bars.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes superior product quality, especially in PC steel wire and stainless steel bars, achieved through early product development, specialized processing equipment, and strict quality control. Its aluminum continuous casting technology offers unique capabilities for producing small diameter bars critical for automotive lightweighting. Geographic proximity to key domestic markets enables rapid delivery and strong customer service.
